summary: Derived a complete finite joint prescribed-projective-line and canonical moving-ratio count with the proposed local main factor and error O_eta(2^omega(H)*(U^(7/4+eta)+V)*log^2(2U)), pending separate review. Line prescriptions split S=QR into Q|u and (u,R)=1 with c_H=rho*u mod R, explicitly covering primes dividing u and nonunit row entries. Double completion retains the zero c-frequency, separates the zero v-frequency exactly and handles every squarefree H divisor, including empty intervals. Weighted phi summation pays 2^omega(R) before its 1/R prefactor absorbs that cost. The result has no positive H power. It gives a relative power saving for fixed positive interval lengths in the subpolynomial-S range when U~X^a,V~X^b,b>3a/4, including balanced sqrt(X) boxes with exponent1/8. The broader arbitrary-aspect power-saving target is not proved; the displayed completion error identifies its precise range limitation without refuting the target. No source full theorem, high list/path moment, actual-prime cancellation, Goldbach proof, breakthrough or novelty claim is obtained. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: The prescribed line conditions are exactly Q|u,(u,R)=1,c_H=rho*u mod R for the stated split S=QR, including p|u and nonunit row-entry cases.
The finite joint count has main UV|I1||I2||I3|kappa_b(H)/prod_(p|S)(p+1) and the displayed uniform absolute error, with every H divisor and CRT/canonical-representative condition retained.

For polynomially sized boxes with b>3a/4 and subpolynomial squarefree S coprime to H, the joint count has an absolute power saving with gamma=min(a,b-3a/4); fixed positive interval lengths also give a relative power saving.
The full arbitrary-aspect power-saving target, accumulated list/path-moment estimates, changed major-arc prime estimate, actual-prime correlation, Goldbach solution and novelty remain unestablished.
